Pass 40 (built green): chunk designation gate (VERIFIED), multi-hop cross-level hauling, and pull-side fetch awareness. Multi-hop now uses a robust one-hop-then-redesignate relay (no fragile carried-item continuation): each landing stores if the level accepts, else sets the item down + re-stamps the Haul designation so the tested single-hop giver carries it onward.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene for DBH, Krkr.rule56 for CAI, Mehni.PickUpAndHaul for bulk-haul) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". NOTE: the auto-PIN of that palette entry can log "Could not find node from path ... Removing." at startup - run it manually from the debug menu. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through.**
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (pass 33)** — EXCEPT we now programmatically re-stamp the vanilla Haul designation on a chunk we set down mid-relay (p40 FIX 5), which is internal plumbing, not a player designator.
- Logistics doctrine: every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + delivered-level retention (pass 34).
- **WORK doctrine (pass 36): the column is ONE BIG MAP for work priority.**
- **HAULING / STORAGE-PRIORITY doctrine (pass 37, REFINED p40):** ONE BIG MAP for storage priority, but a cross-level storage move fires ONLY when the destination tier STRICTLY beats the best storage the item can reach on its OWN level. Equal (or lower) never crosses. Allow Tool Haul Urgently (ignorePins) still crosses. Monotone.
- **HAULABILITY PARITY doctrine (p40, USER-VERIFIED):** cross-level auto-haul mirrors vanilla. A NON-alwaysHaulable thing (stone/slag chunk) is only auto-hauled when DESIGNATED (Orders -> Haul) or already in storage; corpses are alwaysHaulable and unaffected. Enforced in `TargetLevelFor` AND `CrossLevelHaulChain.CanStartFor`.
- **MULTI-HOP HAULING doctrine (p40, "stop at first level that accepts it"):** a stack whose only accepting storage is 2+ levels away is moved ONE gap at a time and stored at the NEAREST accepting level. Execution = one-hop-then-relay: the far giver issues a single `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels` hop toward the far destination; on landing, `CrossLevelHaulChain.OnArrive` STORES here if this level accepts, else SETS THE ITEM DOWN and re-stamps the Haul designation (non-alwaysHaulable only) so the ordinary single-hop / far givers carry it the rest of the way. No carried item is threaded through a re-entrant follow-up job (that was the "stops at the top of the first flight, never continues, RMB says no spot configured" bug). Origin never accepts it, so no bounce-back; cap-3 bounds the relay.
- **PULL-SIDE doctrine (p40 FIX 6):** the idle FETCH giver is far-destination aware, so an idle pawn on level A goes to level B to START a 2+ gap haul (fixes "won't go downstairs to haul to the second floor"). `CanStartFor` intentionally NOT gated on VirtualScanActive (TryStartFarHaul does no virtual swaps, safe to evaluate inside the fetch scan).
- **COMBAT:** projectiles spawn on the TARGET map. VISUALS (p38): real 1:1 projectile. FoW (p39): optional CAI 5000.
- **Soft-compat HARD RULE (p35):** foreign types never in a SIGNATURE/field. CAI reflection-only.
- **RE-ENTRANCY HARD RULE (p40):** re-entering a patched vanilla method, a foreign prefix may skip the original and leave nulls; coalesce at the boundary. ALSO: do NOT start a follow-up job (TryTakeOrderedJob) re-entrantly from inside a stair-transfer callback that carries an item - prefer setting the item down + re-designating and letting a fresh giver pick it up.

# PASS 40 — HAUL/MENU FIX WAVE (BUILT GREEN 0/0, verifying in-game)
- **FIX 1** bulk-haul heavy-stack fallback + no walk-the-queue.
- **FIX 2** cross-level RMB red error (Melee Animation postfix NRE) - coalesce re-entrant result/context.
- **FIX 3** equal-tier storage never crosses.
- **FIX 4** vanilla HAULABILITY PARITY - chunks need Orders->Haul or in-storage. (USER-VERIFIED "chunks issue is fixed".)
- **FIX 5** MULTI-HOP cross-level hauling. FIRST cut used a re-entrant carried-item continuation job -> the item stopped at the top of the first flight and was left UNDESIGNATED (RMB "no spot configured"). REWORKED to one-hop-then-relay (drop + re-stamp Haul designation; see doctrine). `CrossLevelHaulChain.TryStartFarHaul` (coarse whole-column `LevelAcceptsItem` at distance 2, strictly-better-than-bestLocal, haulability gate) fires from the two low-priority givers when `TargetLevelFor` is null, issuing `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels` (SAME driver `JobDriver_HaulAcrossLevels`, `Chain==true` just arms the OnArrive pending order). Single-hop `AB_HaulAcrossLevels` path UNCHANGED.
- **FIX 6** FETCH far-destination aware (`WorkGiver_ABFetchFromOtherLevels` also checks TryStartFarHaul).

# PASS 39 — OPTIONAL CAI 5000 (Krkr.rule56) (phases 1-3 built green, pending verify)
# 38 COMBAT VISUALS · 37 STORAGE-PRIORITY HAUL · 36 ONE-BIG-MAP WORK (VERIFIED) · 36b AIM POSE (VERIFIED) · 36c MODDED TURRET · 35 DBH/GRAVSHIP/DELETE/LEVELGEN · 34 · 33 SEE-BELOW INPUT (VERIFIED)

## Modern Dev Tools integration — SHIPPED About/known-issues.json (inert without MDT).

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (r7). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (r12). Stairwell heat exchange. CROSS-LEVEL TRACERS (p38). Equal-tier lateral cross-level storage moves (p40). Auto-haul of UNDESIGNATED loose chunks (p40). Carried-item re-entrant multi-hop continuation (p40, replaced by drop+re-designate relay).

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · mech charge · bill supply + mech RMB · p33 see-below input · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose · **p40 chunk designation gate (FIX 4)**.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Biomes! Caverns · Alpha Biomes · BM+MO · Odyssey+VLE · Misc. Robots/++ · **Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream (bulk cross-level; heavy-stack fallback p40; far chain single-item)** · Allow Tool · Ancient urban ruins · CE (p38) · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · Modern Dev Tools · Perspective: Ores · CAI 5000 / Krkr.rule56 (p39) · Melee Animation / Float Sub-Menus (p40 coalesce) · turrets: any Building_Turret w/ projectile verb (p36c) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded, non-projectile/CE-verb turrets across levels.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + dev-built column)
**PASS 40 (TOP):**
- FIX 5 (multi-hop relay, current): designated basement chunks + chunk stockpile on the SKY only (surface bare) -> chunks are carried basement->surface (set down + re-designated) -> surface->sky (stored). Must NOT stall at the surface / go undesignated. Add a SURFACE stockpile -> stop at surface. Watch for a chunk left set-down-but-designated with nowhere to go (should not happen - `AnyLinkedLevelAccepts` gates the re-designate).
- FIX 6 (pull side): idle GROUND pawn fetches a designated BASEMENT chunk and relays it to the SKY.
- FIX 4 (VERIFIED) · FIX 3 (equal priority) · FIX 1 (Mehni.PickUpAndHaul no loop) · FIX 2 (co.uk.epicguru.meleeanimation no red RMB error).
**PASS 39 CAI 5000** (Krkr.rule56). 38 · 37 · 36c · 35 queues.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement/light/RMB/below-view diagnostics · cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub self-tests · CAI fog self-test (p39).

## Status
2026-07-26 (pass 40, BUILT GREEN 0/0, verifying in-game): chunk designation gate USER-VERIFIED. Reworked multi-hop hauling from a fragile re-entrant carried-item continuation (item stalled at the top of the first flight, left undesignated -> RMB "no spot configured") to a robust one-hop-then-relay: each landing stores if the level accepts, else sets the item down + re-stamps the Haul designation so the tested single-hop giver finishes the trip. Pull-side fetch is far-destination aware. Testing ISOLATED + dev column; PUAH + Melee companions.
